_readme: The programme's standard terms per era, from the firm's own pages (Common Crawl captures while the Internet Archive was under cooldown; the capture URL is the citation, COLLECTION.md s1). A programme entry cites the terms document of its era (COLLECTION.md s6, programme terms; decisions.md D3).

eras.terms: up to EUR 50K per team, in exchange for a small minority stake; 5 of the 20 Seedcamp Week teams selected
eras.quote: At the end of the Seedcamp week, we will select 5 teams out of the 20 to receive an investment of €50K per team ... The winning companies will receive up to €50K per team to support living and operational expenses in London for three months, in exchange for a small minority stake in the company

eras.terms: up to EUR 50K per team for 8%-10%
eras.quote: The winning companies will receive up to €50K per team to support living and operational expenses in London for three months, in exchange for a small minority stake (8%-10%) in the company with a straightforward set of terms

eras.terms: EUR 75K for 7% (the programme, 'our pre-seed investment'); 3% as a structured warrant (no cash; decisions.md E1); up to EUR 200K into a seed round of EUR 300K-2M (negotiated, not programme terms)
eras.quote: Seedcamp will continue to invest in three ways: €75K for 7% 3% as a Warrant Up to €200K into a seed round between €300K and €2m
also: https://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2017-22-index?url=http%3A%2F%2Fseedcamp.com%2Fstructured-warrant%2F&output=json (2017-05-26: 'Founders who have already raised capital ... can benefit ... through a 3% Warrant')

eras.terms: GBP 100K for 7.5% as the firm's lead first cheque (standard terms); co-investment in seed rounds of up to GBP 2M led by another investor (negotiated, not programme terms)
eras.quote: We will lead your first investment with a cheque of £100K for 7.5% equity. We will co-invest in seed rounds of up to £2M as long as you have a lead investor.
eras.end: By 2020-11-26 the answer is 'We will lead your pre-seed round with investment of around £200K, usually in exchange for an ownership stake between 6% – 7%' (a range, not a standard deal) and by 2020-12-01 'Our first cheque is usually between $350K-$1M': from late 2020 every entry takes the round its own record names (decisions.md D3).
